card.name: Inside the word intramuscularly
card.fires_on: The piece "cular" inside "intramuscularly", right before the final "ly", in injection route statements such as "may be administered intramuscularly or intravenously".

modes.label: Route of injection
modes.description: The "cular" ending of intramuscularly after "administered" or "given" in dosage and administration text.
modes.example: Glycopyrrolate injection may be administered intramus<<cular>>ly (IM), or intravenously

card.writes: It seems to push toward adverb endings like "atively" and "ally", which suits finishing a long adverb.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word intramuscularly when the label says how an injection may be given.
